name: 95032 · Los Gatos, CA
findings: ZIP 95032 (Los Gatos) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95032 (Los Gatos) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
